about.p2: I also have experience with servers and office systems. That helps me understand not only how a site looks, but how it stays online and works day to day.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.description: Common questions from hiring managers and freelance clients.

redesign.question: Can you redesign an existing site?
redesign.answer: Yes. I can audit the current UI, plan a cleaner structure, and rebuild or restyle pages in React / Next.js while keeping what already works.

figma.question: Do you build from Figma?
figma.answer: Yes. I implement Figma designs as pixel-accurate, responsive components — with reusable patterns so the UI stays consistent as it grows.

apis.question: Can you integrate APIs?
apis.answer: Yes. I regularly wire front-ends to REST APIs, including auth, forms, and typed clients when a generated TypeScript SDK is available.

performance.question: Do you optimize performance?
performance.answer: Yes. I focus on fast first paint: image optimization, code splitting, lean client JS, and sensible Core Web Vitals practices.

support.question: Do you support or maintain existing projects?
support.answer: Yes. I can join an existing codebase, fix bugs, ship features, and improve structure without a full rewrite unless one is actually needed.
